channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Russell Westbrook | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Russell Westbrook from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Justin Martinez:Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Russell Westbrook:

“He’s as dynamic as they come in terms of an NBA player, personality and teammate. He’s the whole package. He laid the foundation we stand on now. Part of the reason why this city is what it is is because of Russell Westbrook. He deserves all of those flowers.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Russell Westbrook, Oct 5, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Sam Presti on Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Sam Presti:

“I also want to take a moment to congratulate Russell [Westbrook] on just an unbelievable career. A Hall of Fame career. We are very fortunate that a lot of those years took place in Oklahoma City.”

Sam Presti on Russell Westbrook, Sep 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Patrick Beverley on Chris Paul, Rajon Rondo, James Harden, Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Patrick Beverley:

“I signed a three-year $40 million contract with the Clippers. I turned down a three-year $50 million with Sacramentojust to stay with the Clippers. For me to be there, all the great guards they've had, I was part of that starting five that helped the Clippers go to the first time ever Western Conference Finals. They've had great guards. They've had James Harden, they had Russell Westbrook, they have Chris Paul, they've had Rajon Rondo. They had a plethora of point guards that just can never help them get over the hump, but I was part of that starting five that helped them finally, first time ever, and they haven't been back since, get to the Western Conference Finals.”

Patrick Beverley on Chris Paul, Rajon Rondo, James Harden, Russell Westbrook, Sep 9, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Danny Green on Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Danny Green on where Russell Westbrook ranks all time among point guards:

“Even if you don't respect his body of work, he's got to be in your top 10,even if you don't like him. Just because of what he's done. We never thought we see anybody else average a triple double again. He made it look easy”

Danny Green on Russell Westbrook, Sep 4, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Sam Presti on Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Thunder Executive Vice President and General Manager Sam Presti:

“Russell Westbrook is the ultimate competitor. His internal belief and unbridled fearlessness helped establish the foundation of our organization from day one in 2008and he elevated the confidence and inspired our community in every year thereafter. Russell will be as successful in his life after basketball as he was during his career because his qualities and gifts transfer. His impact on our community is still felt today, and he is beloved for his devotion as much as his talent. He built a Hall of Fame career not by making statements or simply by breaking records, he did it by showing us all the power of asking one simple question: Why Not?”

Sam Presti on Russell Westbrook, Aug 12, 2026. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Alex Abrines on Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Abrines told Cope that

“Westbrook was incredibly kind to me. When I wanted to quit, he took me out to dinner, and it was great.”

Alex Abrines on Russell Westbrook, Mar 13, 2026. Source: Sporting News.

item.title: Amen Thompson on LeBron James, Rajon Rondo, John Wall, Russell Westbrook
item.description:
“I also like how they can command the floor. I’ve been a LeBron, Westbrook and John Wall fan. And then I started watching Rondo and was like, ‘Yo, this man is nice.’ “I knew he was nice, but I didn’t know he was that nice,”

Amen Thompson on LeBron James, Rajon Rondo, John Wall, Russell Westbrook, Dec 4, 2025. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Ivica Zubac on John Wall, Russell Westbrook
item.description:
“I think the fit in Phoenix, I don't think it was really good for him. He's got a real point guard now in James and now Chris too. I think that's going to make life so much easier for him. We saw when he played for the Wizards, playing with the real point guard in John Wall and then later with Russell Westbrook, he's a scoring machine. He can get you a 30 points a night, so I think the fit with us is going to be much better and that's going to make life much easier for him.”

Ivica Zubac on John Wall, Russell Westbrook, Sep 23, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Jeff Teague on Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Teague said on the Club 520 Podcast.

“He not have a better career than Russell Westbrook. He won championships, but this is an individual award. Give me Russell Westbrook. He don't have no league MVP. You was never the best player in the NBA. You've never been the best player in the NBA.”

Jeff Teague on Russell Westbrook, Aug 27, 2025. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Kevin Durant on LeBron James, Sam Presti, James Harden, Russell Westbrook
item.description:
“I'm averaging 30 at 21 years old. Russell [Westbrook] was 22 years old as an All-Star, James [Harden] Sixth Man at 22, so we exceeded the timeline, so they wasn't ready for that. That's just my theory. I don't know exactly what Sam [Presti] was thinking or the owner, but my theory is that I don't think they were ready exactly for us to be contenders every year.”

Kevin Durant on LeBron James, Sam Presti, James Harden, Russell Westbrook, Jul 1, 2025. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Sam Presti on Chris Paul, Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Sam Presti:

“Chris Paul is another guy. He's obviously not just a factor in our history but basketball in Oklahoma.. We played Russell in the playoffs. For him to be in the building in these situations, you have to look back on it and take it all in.”

Sam Presti on Chris Paul, Russell Westbrook, Jun 30, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Gilbert Arenas on Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Gilbert Arenas on who’s the source on Westbrook article:

“You say immature, then it has to be an older player who’s been there for a couple years, that won championship. There’s only like four of them. I’m pretty sure we could probably cancel out Jokic cuz he did want West. You ain’t going to say Murray. You ain’t going to say the one who defended him. There’s only a few going after that. I mean, it ain’t going to be no bench players cuz no one gives a [__] what they thinking about anyway.”

Gilbert Arenas on Russell Westbrook, May 15, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:SGA on the OKC fan response to Russell Westbrook in Game 1 vs Game 2:

“The ovation is beautiful. The things he’s done for this city, for this organization, he deserves it. And what he’s done for this game.. The boo’s tonight.. Our crowd, they got it.. They always have our back.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Russell Westbrook, May 8, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Jamal Murray on Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Jamal Murray on Russell Westbrook:

“I don't think it was just that three though. He makes a lot of winning plays, stuff that doesn't show up in the stat sheet. I don't just watch the shots that he makes. He was 5-of-17 and it doesn't matter to me.”

Jamal Murray on Russell Westbrook, Apr 19, 2025. Source: Twitter @NBABlackburn.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Nikola Jokic on if he would say anything to Russell Westbrook after tonight's ending:

“Why? What happened, it’s basketball. I’m pretty sure that he didn’t want to make a foul or whatever. It happens. He had the best, I would say, thoughts. It happens.”

Nikola Jokic on Russell Westbrook, Apr 2, 2025. Source: Twitter @VBenedetto.

item.title: Kevin Durant on James Harden, Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Kevin Durant on James Harden saying KD and Russell Westbrook showed him how to be a pro:

“It was like Voltron was formed when we all got together….The great ones put that work in and still have that mindset and aggressiveness to do what you worked on in the game. James was always like that”

Kevin Durant on James Harden, Russell Westbrook, Jan 28, 2025. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Michael Malone on Russell Westbrook, Aaron Gordon
item.description:
Ryan Blackburn:Michael Malone on starting Russell Westbrook last night and if that's a permanent move without Aaron Gordon:

“We'll see. It's not written in stone... Russ has been great for us as a starter.”

Michael Malone on Russell Westbrook, Aaron Gordon, Dec 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @NBABlackburn.

item.title: Michael Malone on Russell Westbrook
item.description:
“And what I love about Russell Westbrook: 17-year vet, leopards don’t change their spots, but he is trying so hard to be disciplined. He’s trying to do the things we’re asking him to do, and I appreciate that so much. Because a lot of times at 17 years in, you are who you are. But he cares, man. He is so invested in this team and what he’s bringing to this team, and he’s so hard on himself. I can coach a guy like Russell Westbrook any day.”

Michael Malone on Russell Westbrook, Nov 7, 2024. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Calvin Booth on Russell Westbrook, Nikola Jokic
item.description:
He said, for example, Jokic was a big proponent of signing Russell Westbrook to be the team's backup point guard.

“I think more than anything, [Jokic] loves [Westbrook's] passion for the game,”

Calvin Booth on Russell Westbrook, Nikola Jokic, Nov 1, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Terance Mann on Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Terance Mann on Russell Westbrook:

“One of the best teammates I ever had... looking forward to that competitive nature tomorrow that he's going to bring to the game”

Terance Mann on Russell Westbrook, Oct 25, 2024. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Oscar Robertson on Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Oscar Robertson:

“Speaking of Westbrook, I think that it's unfortunate for Westbrook that they're doing some of these things to him because I think the guy is very valuable to any team he's with but somehow they want to blame somebody. Why blame him man the guy's effective for you, I mean he kept the franchise in Oklahoma going for years.”

Oscar Robertson on Russell Westbrook, Sep 24, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Shaun Livingston on Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Shaun Livingston:

“When KD came in, it was a shock. I was sitting in the barber’s chair, and I remember seeing on my phone, 'KD to the Warriors.'I showed the barber, and he was shocked. It really hit home when he got into training camp and walked through the door. I played in OKC with James, Russell, and KD in their first two years when they were young guys. But by this time, it’s KD. Watching him, I remember watching him warm up and go through his workout for the first time. I was just sitting there like a fan. We already won a championship by this time. We felt like we were made men, but we were watching him like a fan.”

Shaun Livingston on Russell Westbrook, Aug 27, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jamahl Mosley on Russell Westbrook
item.description:
For Suggs, attacking in transition at supersonic speed—particularly after a made basket—is his signature move.

“You see when he pushes it, it’s like Russell Westbrook down the court, flying through the lane,”

Jamahl Mosley on Russell Westbrook, Dec 20, 2023. Source: The Ringer.

item.title: Will Hardy on Russell Westbrook
item.description:
“And that whatever the decision ends up being, that he’s always welcome here with me. I’ve had a lot of respect for him for a long time. I’ve been on staffs in San Antonio in particular where we played Oklahoma City in the playoffs a lot, so I’ve seen Russell up close and personal. You know, his reputation speaks for itself. “And so as a coach, it was really just about opening the line of communication that if there was anything that he needed from me, any conversations that he wanted to have, any questions he had about the situation here in terms of the team day to day, that I was available.”

Will Hardy on Russell Westbrook, Oct 28, 2023. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Austin Reaves on Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Austin Reaves on Russell Westbrook:

“Yeah, he's one of the best teammates I've ever had as a person, you know, you can't get much better. I got COVID in December of my rookie year in Minnesota, and I was stuck there for like seven days. It was rough, but, you know, he reached out like three or four times, asked me if I needed anything, offered to send me stuff, whatever I needed. So as a person, you know, you couldn't get better.”

Austin Reaves on Russell Westbrook, Jul 22, 2023. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Monte McNair on Kevin Durant, Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Internally, they feel strong about their performance in that first-round, seven-game defeat against the Warriors.

“At the time, (the league) had (Kevin Durant) going to Phoenix, (Russell) Westbrook going to the Clippers, Kyrie (Irving to Dallas) and all this stuff. We kind of stood pat…”

Monte McNair on Kevin Durant, Russell Westbrook, Jul 19, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Darvin Ham on Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Darvin Ham on coaching Russell Westbrook:

“Shout out to Russ, man. He takes a lot of blame and everybody seems to want to talk stuff about him.... I appreciate him for just giving it a chance and complying with what I wanted to do and just to take a bullet for the team.”

Darvin Ham on Russell Westbrook, Jul 17, 2023. Source: marcstein.substack.com.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Durant on Westbrook:

“When he retires, people are going to really tell the truth about how they feel about his game. Right now it's a fun thing to do is to make a joke out of Russ, but the way he's been playing since he got with Clippers, he's shown everybody who he really is.”

Kevin Durant on Russell Westbrook, Apr 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @hoopshype.

item.title: Chris Paul on Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Chris Paul on the criticism of Russell Westbrook:

“I feel like the only people to do that are the people that don't know basketball.”

Chris Paul on Russell Westbrook, Apr 22, 2023. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Blazers coachChauncey Billups on Russell Westbrook's fit with the Clippers:

“I thought it was a good gamble to take, to be honest with you. They are what they both needed at this time, if that makes sense. Russ needed somebody that was going to hug him.”

Chauncey Billups on Russell Westbrook, Apr 8, 2023. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.
